interpretation: Four-segment audio shows a larger first-emotion distribution response to audio swaps, with all five permutation means higher.
The paired emotion-NLL delta for audio_all is +0.0037686; exploratory 95% interval [-0.0034211, +0.0110836] crosses zero. This does not establish improved use of correct audio labels.
The audio emotion difference is larger on previous32 (+0.0137468) than additional96 (+0.0004425).
The fusion-only swap response also changes after joint retraining; the result cannot be assigned solely to the four direct audio tokens.
